text.p: -- Robert Flemings said it raised its rating on Mexican construction firm Bufete Idustrial S.A. to speculative buy from hold.
Analyst Ben Uglow said the company shows improved fundamentals due to new project awards and margin gains.
-- Uglow said Bufete also had the potential for winning substantive energy-related projects in 1997 in Mexico.

-- "The recommendation is considered speculative in that the fundamental valuations remain high for this stock. However, it is our view that this would not preclude a material upward movement in the share price in the face of ongoing improvements in revenue and capital structure," he wrote.
-- Uglow changed the company's 1996 net loss estimate to 105.3 million pesos from 125.6 million and raised the projected earnings for 1997 by 52 percent to 97.6 million pesos.
